title: Yle Uutisten taajuussanakirja — a news-based Finnish frequency dictionary
description:
Corpus frequencies for the headwords of the Kotus nykysuomen sanalista, counted against the Yle Finnish News Archive (YLENEWS_FI) 2011–2024. 87 870 attested headwords with their sanalista word classes and total corpus occurrences, plus per-word-class subdictionaries and a top-10 000 list covering 94.95% of all corpus tokens.

Counts are POS-merged because the corpus tagger is not reliable enough to split them; the 43 homonyms whose senses are genuinely different parts of speech were disambiguated by hand.
notes: Derived from the Yle Finnish News Archive 2011–2024 (© Yle, CC BY 4.0, distributed by FIN-CLARIN / The Language Bank of Finland) and the Kotus Nykysuomen sanalista (© Kotimaisten kielten keskus, CC BY 4.0). Both upstream sources require attribution in their own right.
